summary: Load a local HTML file into a BrowserWindow renderer.

target.notes: Generic HTML loading requires a renderer/web runtime unless a separate HTML-to-native pipeline proves this resource can be compiled.

caveats: File path is relative to the application root under Electron.
query/search/hash options affect the generated file URL.
Do not replace with File.ReadAllText; DOM execution and load events are observable.

tests.name: successful local load
tests.expected_behavior: promise fulfills only after the page finishes loading

tests.name: failed load
tests.expected_behavior: promise rejects in correspondence with did-fail-load
